patentId.description: Patent IDs, multiples separated by English commas, upper limit 100, maximum length 60,000 characters; priority is given when it exists together with `patentNumber`.

patentNumber.description: Public announcement numbers, multiple ones separated by English commas, the upper limit is 100, and the maximum length is 60,000 characters.

replaceByRelated.description: Whether to replace the current patent specification with a similar patent family when it cannot be obtained: `1` yes, `0` no, the maximum length is 1,000 characters.
